summary: All nine round-one issues are fixed. The openers are now place-specific developments, the sequences no longer pay off past choices or recast the same classmate, the afternoon/evening wording holds in both slots, the canon fixes are in, and night_suspicion now defers through a castle break. Two small polish items remain; neither blocks.

issues.problem: Left say step 3 opens 'Sincere again.' A sequence counts showings, not choices, so a player who wrote the magnificent letter the first two times is told they were sincere before.
issues.fix: Drop 'again': 'It doesn't get easier to mean it; you only get better at it. The professor nods at the last line and doesn't make you read it aloud.'

issues.problem: Text step 1 now ends 'The third one along has a draught behind it.' On the same showing, the non-member right say opens 'The third gargoyle has a draught behind it that comes from no wall', so the player reads the same beat twice in a row.
issues.fix: Start that say with what the player does: 'You scrub around the draught slowly, and it comes from no wall. You feel for the edge of something.'
